# @sharadox/email-web-library

> Send email from web applications through any SMTP server (Nodemailer underneath): configuration from the environment, checked messages, one error type, and an email layout in a brand's design.

- /email-server-configuration: readEmailServerConfiguration(environment = process.env) → { host, port (587), username, password, security ("starttls" | "tls" on 465 | "none"), timeout? } from EMAIL_SERVER_HOST, _PORT, _USERNAME, _PASSWORD, _SECURITY; throws EmailError("configuration") naming what's missing; with EMAIL_SERVER_AMAZON_SES_ROLE (role ARN) + EMAIL_SERVER_AMAZON_SES_REGION it returns { kind: "amazon-ses", region, credentials } instead, credentials from Vercel OIDC (awsCredentialsProvider), SMTP variables ignored
- /email-sender: createEmailSender(configuration) → { send(message) → { messageId, accepted, rejected }, verify() }; one short connection per send (serverless); refused recipients reported, all refused or any server failure → EmailError("delivery") without the password or message content; an { kind: "amazon-ses" } configuration goes to createAmazonSesSender
- /amazon-ses-sender: createAmazonSesSender({ kind: "amazon-ses", region, credentials: () => Promise<{ accessKeyId, secretAccessKey, sessionToken? }>, timeout? = 10000 }) → EmailSender through the Amazon SES API v2 (one raw MIME email built by Nodemailer); accepted = every recipient, rejected = []; verify() only resolves the credentials; failures → EmailError("delivery") with "Amazon SES (<region>)"
- /email-message: checkEmailMessage(message) (valid addresses, one-line subject, at most RECIPIENT_LIMIT recipients, SUBJECT_LIMIT characters); EmailMessage { from, to, cc?, bcc?, replyTo?, subject, text, html?, inlineImages? [{ id, filename, contentType, content }] }
- /inline-image: inlineImage(id, { filename, contentType, content (base64) }) → InlineImage with the bytes decoded (a library's logo kept as base64 text)
- /email-address: checkEmailAddress(value, field) → the address, or EmailError("invalid-message"); EmailAddress = string | { name, address }
- /email-error: EmailError(code: "configuration" | "invalid-message" | "delivery", message, options?)
- /email-layout: emailLayout(content, design, logos: { light, dark } | boolean) → HTML the same in every mail app: centered 600px column, 16px around, no background; strong #000000 (logo, heading, values, company name, site) and soft #5E5E5E (labels, other text), dark theme #FFFFFF/#A1A1A1 via @media prefers-color-scheme and [data-ogsc] (the only <style>), white logo "logo-dark" shown there; spaces 4/8/16/32 (EMAIL_SPACES); Geist else system sans (EMAIL_FONT); EmailDesign { name, logo? {width,height}, wordmark?, signature? }; EmailContent { language, preview, eyebrow, heading, paragraphs?, rows? [{ label, value: string | string[] (dotted list), href?, keepLines? }], closing? ("Best regards," then the company name in bold) }
- Root import (all of the above) kept in 0.5 for compatibility, removed in 0.6.
